full_prompt_en: A square color portrait photograph shows a blond boy standing outdoors before a modest blue-gray house in a sandy, sparsely vegetated place. He is centered in the frame and visible from the waist upward, looking directly into the camera with a quiet, serious expression. His short light hair falls in a soft side part, and the bright overcast light leaves only gentle shadows beneath the eyes and chin. He wears a pale short-sleeved shirt, buttoned high, with a muted blue-green patterned tie hanging straight down the center. The shirt is tucked into high-waisted gray trousers, whose top edge is visible at the bottom of the image. Behind him to the left, the weathered house has a pitched shingle roof, a dark chimney, and small windows set into its faded siding. Farther to the right, low buildings and a thin utility pole recede into a pale horizon. Dry grass and rough sand fill the foreground and middle distance, their warm beige tones contrasting with the cool walls and shirt. The background is softly out of focus but still recognizable, placing the child in a real environment rather than a studio. The palette is muted and slightly faded, with skin, sandy ground, dull blue, and cream held at low saturation. Natural daylight comes from above and in front, creating even facial detail without a theatrical highlight. Fine photographic grain and restrained contrast give the image a quiet archival quality. No signs or legible writing appear. The overall composition is direct and still, using a centered figure and spare surroundings to make a simple, candid encounter feel memorable.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形彩色肖像照片呈现一名金发男孩站在户外一座朴素蓝灰色房屋前，周围是沙地和稀疏植被。他位于画面中央，可见从腰部向上的身体，直视相机，表情安静而严肃。浅色短发柔和侧分，明亮阴天光只在眼下和下巴留下轻柔阴影。他穿浅色短袖衬衫，扣到较高位置，中央垂下一条柔和蓝绿色花纹领带。衬衫束进高腰灰裤，下沿可见裤腰。左后方，风化的房屋有斜铺瓦屋顶、深色烟囱和嵌在褪色墙板中的小窗。更右侧，低矮建筑和一根细电线杆退向浅色地平线。干草与粗沙填满前景和中景，暖米色与冷色墙面、衬衫形成对照。背景轻轻失焦，但仍可辨认，让孩子处于真实环境而非影棚。色盘柔和且略褪色，皮肤、沙地、暗蓝与奶油色都保持低饱和。自然日光从上方和正前方照来，带来均匀面部细节，没有舞台式亮部。细微摄影颗粒与克制反差赋予影像安静的档案气息。没有标牌或可读文字。整体构图直接而静止，以居中人物和简少环境，让一次坦率的相遇令人难忘。
style_prompt_en: Color documentary photography keeps saturation low and natural, joining faded blue-gray, sandy beige, pale cream, and soft skin tones. Even outdoor light preserves clear central detail while letting the background recede gently through modest depth of field. Fine grain and restrained contrast create an archival texture without heavy distressing. The main form is composed directly and simply, with ordinary surroundings supplying quiet context through small horizontal and vertical lines. Edges are crisp at the focal plane and softer farther away. The overall treatment feels candid, unadorned, and contemplative.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色纪实摄影保持自然低饱和，将褪色蓝灰、沙米色、浅奶油色和柔和肤色联系起来。均匀户外光保留中央清楚细节，适度景深让背景轻轻退后。细颗粒与克制反差营造档案肌理，却没有沉重做旧。主形体以直接简洁方式组织，平凡环境通过小型横竖线条提供安静背景。焦点平面边缘清晰，远处较柔。整体坦率、无装饰且富于沉思。
theme_en: A blond boy standing in front of a small coastal house
theme_zh: 一名金发男孩站在一座小海边房屋前
name: Catherine Opie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
